relations.name: active_runtime_objects
relations.view_sql:
SELECT o.snapshot_id,
    s.git_commit_sha,
    s.source_branch,
    s.authority_scope,
    s.loaded_at,
    o.object_id,
    o.object_type,
    o.source_path,
    o.payload_sha256,
    o.payload,
    s.git_repository_locator,
    s.git_ref,
    s.materialization_version,
    s.manifest_contract,
    s.attempt_no,
    s.activated_at,
    s.activation_git_repository_locator,
    s.activation_git_readback_sha,
    s.activation_git_readback_at,
    s.activation_git_readback_source,
    s.manifest_sha256,
    s.pathset_sha256,
    s.snapshot_sha256,
    s.expected_object_count,
    s.validated_at,
    s.sealed_at
   FROM semantic_atlas.runtime_objects o
     JOIN semantic_atlas.runtime_snapshots s USING (snapshot_id)
  WHERE s.state = 'ACTIVE'::text;

relations.name: canonical_runtime_objects
relations.view_sql:
SELECT snapshot_id,

relations.name: capture_current_state
relations.view_sql:
SELECT e.event_id,
    e.idempotency_key,
    e.record_time,
    e.source_surface,
    e.source_locator,
    e.source_actor,
    e.detector,
    e.trigger_class,
    e.salience,
    e.semantic_key,
    e.candidate_kind,
    e.representation,
    e.representation_fidelity,
    e.privacy_scope,
    e.evidence_ceiling,
    e.notes,
    e.capture_sequence,
    o.action AS latest_action,
    o.semantic_decider,
    o.decision_payload,
    o.git_commit_sha,
    o.git_object_refs,
    o.record_time AS outcome_time,
    o.outcome_sequence
   FROM semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events e
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.outcome_id,
            x.event_id,
            x.record_time,
            x.action,
            x.semantic_decider,
            x.decision_payload,
            x.git_commit_sha,
            x.git_object_refs,
            x.notes,
            x.outcome_sequence
           FROM semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_outcomes x
          WHERE x.event_id = e.event_id
          ORDER BY x.outcome_sequence DESC
         LIMIT 1) o ON true;

indexes.name: capture_policy_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capture_policy_pkey ON semantic_atlas.capture_policy USING btree (policy_key)

relations.name: pending_semantic_captures
relations.view_sql:
SELECT event_id,
    idempotency_key,
    record_time,
    source_surface,
    source_locator,
    source_actor,
    detector,
    trigger_class,
    salience,
    semantic_key,
    candidate_kind,
    representation,
    representation_fidelity,
    privacy_scope,
    evidence_ceiling,
    notes,
    capture_sequence,
    latest_action,
    semantic_decider,
    decision_payload,
    git_commit_sha,
    git_object_refs,
    outcome_time,
    outcome_sequence
   FROM semantic_atlas.capture_current_state
  WHERE latest_action IS NULL OR (latest_action = ANY (ARRAY['HOLD'::text, 'ADJUDICATE_PENDING_GIT'::text]))
  ORDER BY (
        CASE salience
            WHEN 'HIGH'::text THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END), capture_sequence;

constraints.name: runtime_objects_snapshot_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (snapshot_id) REFERENCES semantic_atlas.runtime_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: runtime_objects_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_objects_pkey ON semantic_atlas.runtime_objects USING btree (snapshot_id, object_id)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_node_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_node_idx ON semantic_atlas.runtime_objects USING btree (snapshot_id, ((payload ->> 'node_id'::text))) WHERE (payload ? 'node_id'::text)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_payload_gin
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_payload_gin ON semantic_atlas.runtime_objects USING gin (payload jsonb_path_ops)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_semantic_key_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_semantic_key_idx ON semantic_atlas.runtime_objects USING btree (snapshot_id, ((payload ->> 'semantic_key'::text))) WHERE (payload ? 'semantic_key'::text)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_subject_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_subject_idx ON semantic_atlas.runtime_objects USING btree (snapshot_id, ((payload ->> 'subject_id'::text))) WHERE (payload ? 'subject_id'::text)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_type_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_runtime_objects_type_idx ON semantic_atlas.runtime_objects USING btree (snapshot_id, object_type)

constraints.name: semantic_atlas_active_snapshot_git_readback_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'ACTIVE'::text) OR ((activation_git_repository_locator = git_repository_locator) AND (activation_git_readback_sha = git_commit_sha) AND (activation_git_readback_at IS NOT NULL) AND (activation_git_readback_source IS NOT NULL) AND (length(activation_git_readback_source) > 0))))

constraints.name: semantic_atlas_active_snapshot_verified_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'ACTIVE'::text) OR ((validation_state = 'VERIFIED'::text) AND (validated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (pathset_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (snapshot_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (expected_object_count IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: semantic_atlas_sealed_snapshot_verified_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['SEALED'::text, 'ACTIVE'::text])) OR ((validation_state = 'VERIFIED'::text) AND (validated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (sealed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (pathset_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (snapshot_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (expected_object_count IS NOT NULL))))

indexes.name: runtime_snapshots_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_snapshots_pkey ON semantic_atlas.runtime_snapshots USING btree (snapshot_id)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_one_active_snapshot_per_scope
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_atlas_one_active_snapshot_per_scope ON semantic_atlas.runtime_snapshots USING btree (authority_scope) WHERE (state = 'ACTIVE'::text)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_runtime_snapshot_attempt_uq
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_atlas_runtime_snapshot_attempt_uq ON semantic_atlas.runtime_snapshots USING btree (authority_scope, git_repository_locator, git_commit_sha, materialization_version, attempt_no)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_capture_salience_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_capture_salience_idx ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events USING btree (salience, record_time DESC)

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_capture_semantic_key_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_capture_semantic_key_idx ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events USING btree (semantic_key, record_time DESC) WHERE (semantic_key IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: semantic_capture_events_capture_sequence_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_capture_events_capture_sequence_key ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events USING btree (capture_sequence)

indexes.name: semantic_capture_events_idempotency_key_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_capture_events_idempotency_key_key ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events USING btree (idempotency_key)

indexes.name: semantic_capture_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_capture_events_pkey ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events USING btree (event_id)

constraints.name: semantic_capture_git_confirmation_binding_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((action <> 'GIT_WRITE_CONFIRMED'::text) OR ((semantic_decider IS NOT NULL) AND (git_commit_sha IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(git_object_refs) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(git_object_refs) > 0))))

constraints.name: semantic_capture_outcomes_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_events(event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: semantic_capture_outcomes_git_confirmation_binding_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((action <> 'GIT_WRITE_CONFIRMED'::text) OR ((git_commit_sha IS NOT NULL) AND (git_commit_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'::text) AND (git_authority_scope = ANY (ARRAY['CANONICAL_LEDGER'::text, 'RESEARCH_STAGING'::text])) AND (git_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (length(git_ref) > 0) AND (git_readback_sha = git_commit_sha) AND (jsonb_typeof(git_object_refs) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(git_object_refs) > 0)))) NOT VALID

indexes.name: semantic_atlas_capture_outcomes_event_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX semantic_atlas_capture_outcomes_event_idx ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_outcomes USING btree (event_id, record_time DESC)

indexes.name: semantic_capture_outcomes_outcome_sequence_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_capture_outcomes_outcome_sequence_key ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_outcomes USING btree (outcome_sequence)

indexes.name: semantic_capture_outcomes_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_capture_outcomes_pkey ON semantic_atlas.semantic_capture_outcomes USING btree (outcome_id)
